description: This file contains extensions for the NodeAppModel class, providing normalization functions for handling Watch Notify parameters, actions, priorities, and risk levels within the application related to Watch notifications.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes the provided OpenClawWatchNotifyParams, trimming whitespace, setting default actions, and adjusting priority and risk levels based on existing data.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Filters and limits the list of actions, auto-inserting default actions based on the kind of notification, particularly for approval flows.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Provides a normalized risk level based on the provided risk or defaults derived from priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Provides a normalized priority level based on the provided priority or defaults derived from risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns nil if the string is empty after trimming.
